caption:
There are climbs where mountain biking in Costa Rica becomes a quiet walk. Up on the high ridges where the cloud forest meets the sky, the grade eventually surpasses what gears can offer, and the most honest way forward is on foot. Here, the silence of the highlands takes over. There are no engines, no crowds—just the steady rhythm of your boots in the wet grass and the damp wind coming off the canopy. It is a slow, patient effort that rewards you not with speed, but with a view that goes on forever.
